mapper.select: SELECT act01_account_code_id AS account_code_id , act01_company_id AS company_id , act01_attribute_cd AS attribute_code , f_cdnm('AccountAttributeCode', act01_attribute_cd, act01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS attribute_name , act01_account_cd AS account_code , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END || act01_account_nm AS account_name , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END || act01_account_nm2 AS account_name2 FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn , 'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(act01_slip_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(act01_attribute_cd, '%') LIKE #{attributeCode} AND UPPER(CONCAT(act01_account_cd, act01_account_nm, act01_account_enm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY act01_attribute_cd, act01_print_seq
